title: Run FER simulation over AWGN for full DVB-T2 FEC chain
description:
## Goal

Execute the production AWGN simulation campaign using the binary
delivered by epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`) Phase D task `bbf6b6ee`
for all 6 (rate × modulation) configurations required by this
epic's parent, and check in the resulting CSV / PNG / tracing
artefacts under `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/`.

## Context

This is the terminal child of epic `epic:dvb-t2-awgn-campaign`
(`2928ccce`). All technical risk is upstream (infrastructure,
codec, interleaver, runner, validation, the new `gf2-sim`
pipeline). This task is execution-only: plan the SNR sweeps, run
the campaigns (potentially several days of wall-clock), and curate
the artefacts.

The cross-epic dependency chain is now:

- `e4849f07` → `3fcb7025` (within-SNR parallelism — landed via
  `gf2-sim` Phase A).
- `e4849f07` → `bbf6b6ee` (campaign binary migrated to `gf2-sim`
  pipeline — Phase D `gf2-sim` task).

Once both deps land, this task picks up the migrated binary and
runs the multi-day production sweep using its `--decoder sumproduct
--demap exactlogmap` configuration (per the 2026-05-28 calibration
smoke recommendation in `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/README.md`).

The 2026-06-05 partial campaign run preserved in
`dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/curve_1_2_16qam/checkpoints/` is
INFORMAL and may be discarded or extended at the operator's choice
when this task resumes.

## Deliverables

1. SNR sweep plan at `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/PLAN.md` (already
   exists; refresh with the `gf2-sim`-pipeline invocations when
   `bbf6b6ee` lands).
2. For each of the 6 (rate × modulation) configurations:
   - `curve_<rate>_<mod>.csv`
   - `curve_<rate>_<mod>.png` (simulated vs ETSI TS 102 831 overlay,
     produced by the operator-run plotting script in
     `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/`)
   - `tracing_<rate>_<mod>.jsonl`
3. `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/README.md` summarising results,
   invocation, total wall-clock, host info, and observed gap to
   the ETSI TS 102 831 reference for each curve.
4. Closure note quantifying the achieved gap per curve.

## Success criteria

- [hard] All 6 curves produced.
- [hard] Gap to ETSI TS 102 831 reference ≤ 0.5 dB at FER = 10⁻⁴
  for each curve. If a curve cannot reach this gap, escalate per
  the amendment / escalation policy before closing.
- [aspirational] Achieve ≤ 0.3 dB at FER = 10⁻⁴ on each curve;
  recorded per curve in the closure note where met.
- [hard] ≥ 100 frame errors at each SNR point that brackets
  FER = 10⁻⁴.
- [hard] All artefacts committed under
  `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/`.
- [hard] PLAN.md and README.md present and complete.

## Non-goals

- No new code in this task. Any code change required would
  indicate an upstream slip — escalate rather than patch here.
- No fading channels.

## Notes

- The reference document is **TS 102 831** (ETSI Technical
  Specification), not TR (Technical Report) — typo corrected
  2026-06-07.
- This task's success criteria (gap ≤ 0.5 dB, ≥ 100 errors,
  PNG overlays) are the SSOT for the DVB-T2 production closure.
  Epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`) Phase D delivers the binary but
  does NOT duplicate these criteria, per the 2026-06-07 SSOT
  cleanup.
